title: Syndrome du canal carpien-6 (CTS-6)
formula:
The CTS-6 is calculated by adding the selected points for each variable:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Symptoms and History | | |
| Numbness predominately or exclusively in median nerve territory (Sensory symptoms are mostly in the thumb, index, middle, and/or ring fingers) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3.5 | |
| Nocturnal numbness (Symptoms are prominent when patient sleeps; numbness wakes patient from sleep) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 4 | |
| Physical Examination | | |
| Thenar atrophy and/or weakness (The bulk of the thenar area is reduced or manual motor testing shows strength of grade 4 or less) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 5 | |
| Positive Phalen test (Flexion of the wrist reproduces or worsens symptoms of numbness in the median nerve territory) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 5 | |
| Loss of 2 point discrimination (A failure to discriminate two points held 5 mm or less apart from one another in the median nerve innervated digits) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 4.5 | |
| Positive Tinel sign (Light tapping over the median nerve at the level of the carpal tunnel causing radiating paresthesia into the median nerve innervated digits (not proximally)) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 4 | |

how_to_use.why:
- Estimates a patient’s pretest probability for CTS from history and exam without specialized equipment or advanced training.
- Outperforms “gestalt” alone and was similar or superior in specificity to electrodiagnostic studies and ultrasound.
- Helps and avoid unnecessary electrodiagnostics in clear-cut cases and potentially reduces misdiagnosis.
- Endorsed in the[American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS)](https://www.aaos.org/globalassets/quality-and-practice-resources/carpal-tunnel/carpal-tunnel-2024/cts-cpg.pdf)guidelines as an interchangeable clinical diagnostic tool alongside electrodiagnostic studies and ultrasonography.
how_to_use.when: À utiliser en soins primaires ou en soins urgents chez les patients adultes présentant des paresthésies ou des douleurs de la main suspectées d’être dues à un syndrome du canal carpien (CTS).
how_to_use.pearls:
- Developed from 57 candidate findings ranked via Delphi; the top 8 were combined into 256 standardized case histories rated by two expert panels to derive and validate a logistic model, from which 6 items contributed significantly.
- The original work focused on non-disabled adults in hand clinics with clinical/electrodiagnostic confirmation; subsequent validation (including special populations) shows strong discrimination.
- At higher cutoffs (e.g., 12), specificity is high while sensitivity is moderate; a negative result does not rule out CTS.
- Intended as a clinical probability tool; it does not grade disease severity.
- Misclassification can occur with atypical patterns or coexisting neuropathies.

next_steps.advice:
- Les résultats ne doivent pas remplacer le jugement clinique ; intégrez cet outil à l’anamnèse, à l’examen clinique, au contexte de risque (p. ex., grossesse, diabète, hypothyroïdie, utilisation répétitive du poignet) et à la durée des symptômes.
- Excluez les diagnostics différentiels fréquents, tels que la radiculopathie cervicale, la neuropathie médiane proximale, la neuropathie ulnaire et la polyneuropathie généralisée.
next_steps.management:
**Score ≥12:** CTS is more likely.

- Initiate nonsurgical or surgical interventions, as deemed appropriate.
- Electrodiagnostic testing is unlikely to add certainty to the diagnosis.

**Score <12:** CTS is less likely.

- Consider other diagnoses on the differential.
- Electrodiagnostic testing may be considered if suspicion for CTS remains high.

more_info:
Interprétation :

| Score CTS-6 | Probabilité |
| --- | --- |
| <12 | Moins probable |
| ≥12 | Plus probable |

*Un score de 12 correspond à une probabilité pré-test estimée de CTS d'environ 80 %, tandis qu'un score inférieur à 5 correspond à une probabilité pré-test d'environ 25 %.*
short_description: Estimates likelihood de CTS dans adultes.
medium_description: Estimates likelihood de carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS) dans adultes using symptoms et physical exam findings.

input_schema.name: a
input_schema.label: Numbness predominately ou exclusively dans median nerve territory
input_schema.tips: Les symptômes sensitifs siègent principalement au pouce, à l'index, au majeur et/ou à l'annulaire.

input_schema.name: b
input_schema.label: Engourdissement nocturne
input_schema.tips: Les symptômes prédominent lorsque le patient dort ; un engourdissement réveille le patient.

input_schema.name: c
input_schema.label: Atrophie thénarienne et/ou faiblesse
input_schema.tips: Le volume de l'éminence thénar est réduit ou l'évaluation manuelle de la force motrice met en évidence une force de grade 4 ou moins

input_schema.name: d
input_schema.label: Test de Phalen positif
input_schema.tips: La flexion du poignet reproduit ou aggrave les symptômes d'engourdissement dans le territoire du nerf médian.

input_schema.name: e
input_schema.label: Loss de 2 point discrimination
input_schema.tips: Incapacité à discriminer deux points séparés de 5 mm ou moins l’un de l’autre au niveau des doigts innervés par le nerf médian.

input_schema.name: f
input_schema.label: Signe de Tinel positif
input_schema.tips: Percussion légère sur le nerf médian au niveau du canal carpien provoquant des paresthésies irradiant dans les doigts innervés par le nerf médian (et non de façon proximale).
